波克夏第三季減持約 2,750 萬股美國銀行股票，持股季減約 5.7%，降至約 4.559 億股。
波克夏第二季已減持約 3,000 萬股，當時持股降至約 4.834 億股。
相較 2024 年中逾 10 億股的水準，波克夏目前持股已縮減逾半。前執行長巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 尚未公開說明連續減碼的原因。
13F 出爐前指出，波克夏第三季財報顯示，金融類股投資的成本基礎下降，同期也認列部分股票投資處分利益，這些跡象讓外界推測波克夏可能再度減持美國銀行。
Capital One 也連續兩季遭大幅減碼。
波克夏第二季已賣出約 400 萬股，將持股降至 300 萬股，第三季再賣出約 185 萬股，減幅約 62%，期末持股剩約 115 萬股。
Lennar A 類股近翻倍 Bending Spoons 首度入列
波克夏第三季增持近 1,292 萬股 Lennar A 類股，持股由 6 月底的 1,311 萬股增至 9 月底的 2,603 萬股，季增 98.6%。
以 Lennar 9 月 30 日收盤價 81.59 美元計算，新增的 A 類股市值約 10.5 億美元，是這季按金額計算加碼最多的標的。
這也是波克夏連續第二季加碼 Lennar。相較 3 月底約 1,010 萬股，波克夏持有的 Lennar A 類股半年增加約 158%。同一季，Lennar B 類股也從約 29.8 萬股增至 55.3 萬股。
兩類股票合計季末市值約 21.7 億美元，占 13F 揭露持股市值約 0.7%。
另外兩檔住宅建商 NVR (NVR-US) 與 D.R. Horton (DHI-US) 的持股股數則維持不變。
波克夏第三季也新建倉 Bending Spoons，截至 9 月底持有約 2,069 萬股。
這家擁有 AOL 和 Vimeo 的義大利軟體公司先前透露，波克夏在 7 月首次公開募股 (IPO) 時投入 6 億美元，並在 10 月再投入 3.3 億美元，將持股比例提高至約 4%。
其他持股方面，波克夏第三季加碼達美航空 (DAL-US)，Alphabet 持股股數維持不變。截至 9 月底，蘋果、美國運通、可口可樂、Alphabet 與美國銀行仍是 13F 揭露的前五大持股，合計占申報持股市值約 68%。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) disclosed its third‑quarter 13F filing on Monday the 16th, marking the ninth straight quarter of reducing its Bank of America (BAC-US) stake and slashing its Capital One Financial (COF-US) holding by more than 60%. On the buying side, Berkshire’s position in U.S. homebuilder Lennar (LEN-US) Class A shares almost doubled, rising to about 26.03 million shares, and it disclosed a new position in Italian software firm Bending Spoons (BSP-US).

As of the end of September, the market value of the holdings reported in Berkshire’s 13F was roughly $304.2 billion, representing the bulk of its total $335.5 billion equity portfolio. Berkshire’s third‑quarter 10‑Q, released earlier this month, showed purchases of about $2.4 billion in stocks and sales of about $2.8 billion, a net sale of roughly $0.4 billion.
Bank of America reduced by about 27.5 million shares; Capital One stake cut by more than 60%
In the third quarter Berkshire sold about 27.5 million Bank of America shares, a quarterly decline of roughly 5.7% to about 455.9 million shares.
In the second quarter Berkshire had sold about 30 million shares, bringing its holding down to roughly 483.4 million shares.

Compared with the more than 1 billion‑share level in mid‑2024, Berkshire’s current stake is now down by more than half. Former CEO Warren Buffett has not publicly explained the consecutive reductions.

Ahead of the 13F release, Berkshire’s third‑quarter report showed that the cost basis of its financial‑sector investments fell and that it recognized some gains from stock disposals, leading observers to speculate that Berkshire might further trim its Bank of America position.
Capital One also saw large reductions for two consecutive quarters.

In the second quarter Berkshire sold about 4 million Capital One shares, lowering its holding to 3 million shares; in the third quarter it sold another roughly 1.85 million shares, a 62% drop, leaving about 1.15 million shares at quarter‑end.
Lennar Class A shares nearly double; Bending Spoons added for the first time

In the third quarter Berkshire added roughly 12.92 million Lennar Class A shares, increasing its stake from 13.11 million shares at the end of June to 26.03 million shares at the end of September, a quarterly gain of 98.6%.
Using Lennar’s September 30 closing price of $81.59, the new Class A shares are valued at about $1.05 billion, making Lennar the largest dollar‑value addition in the quarter.

This is Berkshire’s second consecutive quarter adding to Lennar. Compared with roughly 10.1 million shares at the end of March, the Class A stake grew about 158% over six months. In the same quarter, Lennar Class B shares also rose from about 298,000 to 553,000 shares.
Combined, the two classes were worth about $2.17 billion at quarter‑end, roughly 0.7% of the total market value disclosed in the 13F.
The share counts for the other two homebuilders, NVR (NVR-US) and D.R. Horton (DHI-US), remained unchanged.
Berkshire also opened a new position in Bending Spoons in the third quarter, holding about 20.69 million shares as of the end of September.
The Italian software company, which owns AOL and Vimeo, previously disclosed that Berkshire invested $600 million in its July IPO and another $330 million in October, raising its stake to about 4%.

Other holdings: Berkshire added Delta Air Lines (DAL-US) in the third quarter, while its Alphabet position stayed flat. As of the end of September, Apple, American Express, Coca‑Cola, Alphabet and Bank of America remained the top five holdings in the 13F, together accounting for roughly 68% of the disclosed portfolio value.

items.title: 〈分析〉董事會不理近18萬連署 輝達法說沒有黃仁勳的三大差別
items.title_en: Analysis: Board Ignores Nearly 180,000 Signatures; Nvidia Earnings Call Lacks Jensen Huang's Three Key Differences
paras: 財報公布前夕，要求黃仁勳回任的網路連署已累積近18萬人，美國總統川普周一(16日)也表示不反對。
不過，《CNBC》周一引述知情人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US)董事會目前未考慮或討論讓黃仁勳回任，現階段重心仍是針對他的調查。
輝達已聘請Wachtell Lipton律師事務所，調查黃仁勳的行為是否危及美國國家安全，或造成公司機密外洩。
輝達將於美東時間周二(17日)盤後公布第三季財報，法說會訂於美西時間下午2時舉行，換算台北時間為周三(18日)清晨6時。
本季於10月25日結束，黃仁勳上周四才辭任執行長，整季營運均在他任內進行。《CNBC》指出，這場法說會將由臨時執行長、財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)主持。
《路透社》指出，黃仁勳突然離任，使財報焦點從毛利率與現金運用等既有議題，轉向輝達對整個AI生態系的影響力。
Synovus Trust投資組合經理Dan Morgan預期，輝達第三季營收可能比市場共識約1,090.8億美元高出20億至30億美元，年增率將超過九成。
但Morgan也向《路透社》表示，本周最大的問題是輝達要如何消除不確定性，讓股價突破目前的交易區間。

差別一：遠期展望的說服力

資產管理公司Marlborough駐倫敦股票投資組合經理Rory Dowie上周已出清輝達持股。他認為，黃仁勳離開使輝達獲利面臨更大風險。
Dowie表示，Marlborough傾向布局準備搶占輝達市占的公司；黃仁勳離任，可能讓超微(AMD-US)或博通(AVGO-US)等競爭者更有機會。
輝達股價已從10月高點回落約三分之一。SilverSea資產管理避險基金經理人Max Anderl提醒，估值收縮並非全由黃仁勳離任造成。
Anderl估計，輝達獲利中近三分之一屬非營業項目，來自股權投資評價利益。他指出，若AI產業前景改變，相關投資可能減記，市場成長預期也可能逆轉。
他認為，即使輝達財報持續亮眼，本益比也早在執行長離任前開始收縮。

差別二：法說會上少了他的答問

《CNBC》描述，過往法說會由克瑞斯依準備好的講稿報告季度業績與展望，之後再由黃仁勳回答分析師問題，從公司技術談到整個AI生態系。
周二的法說會將是克瑞斯首次全程主持。投資人將關注她如何回應執行長交接、接班人遴選，以及公司文化與技術領先能否延續等問題。

差別三：他個人撐起的交易號召力

《CNBC》指出，黃仁勳深度介入晶片分配，決定客戶取得供貨的先後順序，也親自推動以輝達資產負債表支持大型資料中心融資。
他8月曾在《CNBC》宣布與六家大型金融機構合作，協助新雲業者(neocloud)及前沿AI實驗室取得融資。
《CNBC》指出，這項計畫至今尚未完成任何交易。克瑞斯是否具備同等的華爾街號召力，或願意繼續動用資產負債表推動晶片銷售，仍有待觀察。
《CNBC》引述輝達最新申報文件報導，公司已承諾的供應與產能支出，本會計年度剩餘期間為920億美元，截至2028年1月的年度為870億美元，2029年度為880億美元。
周三清晨的法說會，首先要看成長展望。《CNBC》報導，克瑞斯在上次法說會預估2028會計年度營收成長約七成，並形容這是「供應受限下的展望」。
其次是中國業務與華府調查。參議員Wyden與眾議員Neal正調查輝達對中晶片銷售的核准過程。
美國財政部長貝森特上周五接受《CNBC》訪問時則問：「真正的故事應該是，輝達到底認不認識自己的客戶？」
最後，市場將檢視克瑞斯首次以臨時執行長身分主持法說，能否在黃仁勳之外建立說服力。這場財報不只反映季度業績，也將讓投資人評估輝達的領導交接、供應承諾與AI產業角色。
paras_en: On the eve of its earnings release, an online petition calling for Jensen Huang's return has amassed nearly 180,000 signatures, and U.S. President Trump also said on Monday (the 16th) that he does not oppose it.
However, CNBC reported on Monday that Nvidia (NVDA-US) board members are currently not considering or discussing Huang's reinstatement; their focus remains on the investigation into him.
Nvidia has hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to probe whether Huang's actions jeopardize U.S. national security or cause leakage of company secrets.

Nvidia will release its third‑quarter results after the market close on Tuesday, Oct. 17 (U.S. Eastern Time), with the earnings call scheduled for 2 p.m. Pacific Time, which is 6 a.m. Wednesday morning in Taipei.

The quarter ended on Oct. 25; Huang stepped down as CEO only last Thursday, so the entire quarter’s operations were conducted under his leadership. CNBC noted that the call will be hosted by interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress.
Reuters pointed out that Huang’s sudden departure shifted the earnings focus from existing topics such as gross margin and cash usage to Nvidia’s influence over the broader AI ecosystem.
Synovus Trust portfolio manager Dan Morgan expects Nvidia’s Q3 revenue could exceed the consensus of about $109.08 billion by $2‑3 billion, implying a year‑over‑year growth rate of over 90%.
Morgan also told Reuters that the biggest issue this week is how Nvidia can eliminate uncertainty and push the stock price out of its current trading range.

Difference 1: Persuasiveness of forward outlook. Marlborough’s London‑based equity portfolio manager Rory Dowie sold his Nvidia position last week, believing Huang’s exit raises profit risks for the company.
Dowie said Marlborough is positioning to back companies that could capture Nvidia’s market share; with Huang gone, rivals such as AMD (AMD-US) or Broadcom (AVGO-US) may have a better chance.

Nvidia’s share price has fallen roughly one‑third from its October peak. Max Anderl, a hedge‑fund manager at SilverSea Asset Management, cautioned that the valuation contraction is not solely due to Huang’s departure.

Anderl estimates that nearly one‑third of Nvidia’s earnings come from non‑operating items, mainly gains from equity‑investment valuations. He warned that if the AI industry outlook changes, those investments could be written down and growth expectations could reverse.
He believes that even if Nvidia’s earnings remain strong, the price‑to‑earnings multiple began compressing before the CEO’s exit.

Difference 2: The earnings call will lack his Q&A. CNBC described that past calls featured Kress delivering a prepared script on quarterly results and outlook, followed by Huang fielding analysts’ questions about technology and the AI ecosystem.

Tuesday’s call will be Kress’s first time hosting the entire session. Investors will watch how she addresses the CEO transition, succession selection, and whether the company’s culture and tech leadership can endure.

Difference 3: His personal deal‑making clout. CNBC noted that Huang was deeply involved in chip allocation, deciding the order in which customers received supply, and personally used Nvidia’s balance sheet to finance large data‑center projects.
In August, he announced on CNBC a partnership with six major financial institutions to help new cloud providers (neocloud) and frontier AI labs obtain financing.

CNBC said the program has not yet completed any transactions. It remains to be seen whether Kress has comparable Wall Street charisma or will continue to leverage the balance sheet to drive chip sales.

CNBC cited Nvidia’s latest filing, which shows the company has committed supply and capacity spending of $92 billion for the remainder of the current fiscal year, $87 billion for fiscal 2028 and $88 billion for fiscal 2029.

The Wednesday‑morning call will first focus on growth outlook. CNBC reported that Kress previously projected roughly 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028 and described it as a “supply‑constrained outlook.”
Next will be discussion of China business and a Washington investigation. Senators Wyden and Representative Neal are probing Nvidia’s approval process for chip sales to China.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen asked in a CNBC interview last Friday, “The real story is whether Nvidia really knows its customers?”

Finally, the market will assess whether Kress, as interim CEO, can establish credibility beyond Huang. This earnings release not only reflects quarterly performance but also forces investors to evaluate Nvidia’s leadership transition, supply commitments and role in the AI industry.

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任前8個月 逾105億美元輝達股票轉入家族信託
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Transfers Over $10.5 Billion of Nvidia Stock to Family Trust in the Eight Months Before Stepping Down
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 共同創辦人黃仁勳卸下執行長職務前約 8 個月，與妻子洛莉 (Lori Huang) 依十年前訂下的安排，將近 5,900 萬股輝達股票轉入家族不可撤銷信託。《巴隆週刊》根據美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 申報文件估算，這批股票在今年 3 月移轉時市值逾 105 億美元。回到 2016 年，夫婦倆投入這兩筆十年期信託的輝達股票，合計市值約 5,100 萬美元。
SEC 申報顯示，兩筆十年期信託於今年 3 月 18 日如期到期，各移出 29,481,301 股，合計 58,962,602 股，全數轉入黃家不可撤銷剩餘財產信託 (Huang Irrevocable Remainder Trust)。
黃仁勳為該信託受託人，移轉後該信託合計持有約 1.09 億股輝達股票。
黃仁勳與洛莉育有一子一女，兩人均曾在輝達任職。
兒子黃勝斌 (Spencer Huang) 曾擔任機器人產品總監，女兒黃敏珊 (Madison Huang) 曾擔任產品行銷資深總監。
SEC 申報未揭露這筆家族信託的受益人姓名。
《巴隆週刊》向輝達及黃家基金會尋求回應，均未獲答覆。
十年前投入 5,100 萬美元 搭上 AI 股價漲勢
2016 年 2 月，輝達仍以遊戲晶片業務為主。
黃仁勳當時在財報電話會議上表示，人工智慧 (AI) 很可能被納入各類應用，這股趨勢已開始擴及不同產業。同年 3 月 16 日，他與妻子以輝達股票設立四筆信託，其中兩筆為四年期，另外兩筆為十年期。
《巴隆週刊》分析 SEC 申報指出，兩筆十年期信託最初投入約 5,100 萬美元的輝達股票，2017 年 5 月合計價值已超過 1.9 億美元，2021 年突破 10 億美元，2023 年 6 月進一步增至約 22.9 億美元。
道瓊市場數據顯示，從信託設立到到期的十年間，輝達股價累計上漲 22,161%，同期標普 500 指數上漲 288%。
波士頓信託與遺產律師 Joshua Caswell 認為，選擇十年期反映黃仁勳對自己和公司有相當大的信心，即使當時難以預料何時能將持股變現。
他表示，自己未曾見過規模達數十億美元的同類案例，並指出這項安排讓夫婦倆移轉的這部分財富免於繳納聯邦遺產稅。
股價漲得越多 可移轉給受益人的資產越多
黃仁勳夫婦採用的是「委託人保留年金信託」(GRAT)。
委託人將股票等資產放入信託，在約定期間內定期領回年金。
以「歸零型」設計為例，年金按美國國稅局 (IRS) 規定的利率折算成現值後，約等於最初投入的資產價值，因而可將設立時的應稅贈與價值降至接近零。
信託到期後，支付完年金所剩的資產可移轉給受益人。信託期間股價漲得越多，通常就有越多資產可供移轉。
曾任遺產律師的 Fidelis Capital 合夥人 Chris Tate 說，GRAT 是美國國稅局認可的財產規劃工具。
若資產報酬低於規定利率，信託到期可能沒有剩餘資產可供移轉，設立人仍須支付法律及行政費用。
若設立人在信託期間身故，部分或全部信託資產也可能被納入應稅遺產。這類信託常見期限為兩年或四年，十年期較少見，因為資產的長期表現更難預測。
三月完成移轉 十一月卸任
這批股票在 3 月依信託約定完成移轉。
到了 11 月，媒體陸續報導黃仁勳多起婚外情，黃仁勳卸下輝達執行長、總裁及董事職務，由財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 代理執行長。
TritonPoint Wealth 執行長 Andrew Schiff 表示，若股價在年金信託到期前下跌，跌勢持續多久、股價能回升多少，都可能大幅影響最終可移轉給受益人的增值。黃家這批股票的逾 105 億美元，是今年 3 月移轉當時的市值。股票轉入家族信託後，價值仍隨輝達股價波動。
paras_en: About eight months before Jensen Huang, co‑founder of Nvidia (NVDA‑US), stepped down as CEO, he and his wife Lori Huang moved roughly 59 million Nvidia shares into an irrevocable family trust under an arrangement they set up ten years ago. According to Bloomberg based on SEC filings, the shares were worth more than $10.5 billion when transferred in March of this year. Back in 2016, the couple had initially placed Nvidia stock worth about $51 million into the two ten‑year trusts.

SEC filings show that the two ten‑year trusts matured on March 18 this year, each releasing 29,481,301 shares for a total of 58,962,602 shares, all of which were transferred into the Huang Irrevocable Remainder Trust.
Jensen Huang serves as trustee of the trust, which now holds approximately 109 million Nvidia shares in total after the transfer.
Jensen and Lori have a son and a daughter, both of whom have previously worked at Nvidia.
Their son, Spencer Huang, previously served as Director of Robotics Products, and their daughter, Madison Huang, was a Senior Director of Product Marketing.
The SEC filing does not disclose the names of the trust’s beneficiaries.
Bloomberg reached out to Nvidia and the Huang Family Foundation for comment and received no response.
Ten years ago they invested $51 million and rode the AI stock surge.
In February 2016 Nvidia was still primarily a gaming‑chip company.

At that time, Huang told analysts on a earnings call that artificial intelligence was likely to be incorporated into many applications and that the trend was already spreading across industries. On March 16 of the same year, he and his wife created four trusts using Nvidia stock—two with four‑year terms and two with ten‑year terms.

Bloomberg’s analysis of the SEC filing notes that the two ten‑year trusts were initially funded with about $51 million of Nvidia stock, which was worth over $190 million by May 2017, broke $1 billion in 2021, and rose to roughly $2.29 billion by June 2023.
According to Dow Jones market data, Nvidia’s share price rose a cumulative 22,161 % over the ten‑year life of the trusts, compared with a 288 % gain for the S&P 500 over the same period.

Boston trust and estate attorney Joshua Caswell said the ten‑year term reflects Huang’s strong confidence in himself and the company, even though it was impossible at the time to predict when the holdings could be liquidated.
He added that he has never seen a comparable case involving tens of billions of dollars, and that the structure allows the portion of wealth transferred by the couple to avoid federal estate tax.
The higher the stock price climbs, the more assets can be passed on to beneficiaries.
The Huangs used a Grantor Retained Annuity Trust (GRAT).
The grantor places assets such as stock into the trust and receives a scheduled annuity payment during the trust term.

With a “zero‑coupon” design, the annuity’s present value—calculated using the IRS‑prescribed interest rate—is roughly equal to the initial asset value, effectively reducing the taxable gift value at creation to near zero.

After the trust term ends and the annuity payments are made, any remaining assets can be transferred to the beneficiaries; the more the stock appreciates during the term, the larger the residual transfer.
Former estate‑lawyer and Fidelis Capital partner Chris Tate explained that GRATs are an IRS‑approved estate‑planning tool.
If the asset’s return falls below the prescribed rate, the trust may have no remaining assets to transfer at termination, and the settlor must still cover legal and administrative costs.

If the settlor dies during the trust term, part or all of the trust assets could be included in the taxable estate. Such trusts are usually set up for two‑ or four‑year terms; ten‑year terms are rare because long‑term performance is harder to predict.
Transfer completed in March; resignation in November.
The shares were transferred in March according to the trust agreement.

By November, media reports surfaced about multiple extramarital affairs involving Huang. He stepped down from his roles as CEO, president and director of Nvidia, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO.

Andrew Schiff, CEO of TritonPoint Wealth, said that if the stock price falls before the annuity trust matures, the duration and depth of the decline—and the subsequent recovery—could dramatically affect the ultimate value transferred to beneficiaries. The Huangs’ stock, valued at over $10.5 billion at the time of the March transfer, continues to fluctuate with Nvidia’s market price after being moved into the family trust.

items.title: 稀土股跌勢加劇！USAR遭降評重挫12% 原料短缺成最新利空
items.title_en: Rare Earth Stocks Accelerate Downward Trend! USAR Slashed 12% After Downgrade, Raw Material Shortage Adds New Headwind
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，華爾街週一(16日)對USA Rare Earth(USAR-US)發布負面評估，引發市場拋售潮，並拖累其他稀土類股同步走跌。這家兼具採礦與製造業務的公司今年以來股價已大幅下挫，與2026年初曾經歷的強勁漲勢形成鮮明對比。
引發市場震盪的關鍵，是投行William Blair分析師調降USA Rare Earth股票評級。分析師週一在報告中指出，公司正面臨原料短缺問題，對股價形成壓力，因此將評級下調至相當於中立的水準，並同步調整營收及獲利預估。
USA Rare Earth股價週一大跌12.6%，創下2025年4月3日以來最低收盤價，當時股價收在6.50美元。跌幅也創下6月5日以來最大單日百分比跌幅，當時該股下跌17%。
今年以來，USA Rare Earth股價已下跌約50%。相較之下，2025年全年股價上漲15%。
其他稀土相關個股週一也同步下挫，包括Critical Metals(CRML-US)、MP Materials(MP-US)及Rare Earths Americas(REA-US)。
William Blair分析師在報告中指出，USA Rare Earth「正逐步建立未來顯著成長的基礎」，但近期原料供應短缺，為公司原本就面臨的短期挑戰再添壓力。稀土原料是指含有稀土元素、且可進一步加工的各類原材料，包括礦石及廢棄物等。
今年稍早，川普政府宣布與USA Rare Earth建立投資及合作關係，因為美國政府將稀土產業視為攸關國家安全的重要領域。
稀土元素在地殼中的含量其實相對豐富，但由於通常不會以純元素形式存在，開採與提煉難度較高，因此被稱為「稀土」。這些礦物廣泛應用於能源、交通運輸，當然也包括人工智慧等產業。
William Blair分析師表示，「考量原料短缺持續造成影響，我們已將營收及利潤率預估大幅延後至2028年。」
分析師也指出，除了原料供應問題外，企業在提高產量、擴大生產規模的過程中，通常還會面臨各種營運挑戰，而整體稀土產業也存在更廣泛的風險。
不過，USA Rare Earth仍有一項有利條件。分析師指出，公司截至9月底一季結束時，持有超過10億美元現金，足以確保公司在明年，甚至原料供應問題持續更久的情況下，仍擁有「充足流動性」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Wall Street on Monday (the 16th) issued a negative assessment of USA Rare Earth (USAR-US), sparking a market sell‑off and dragging other rare‑earth stocks down with it. The mining‑and‑manufacturing company has seen its share price tumble sharply this year, a stark contrast to the strong rally it enjoyed early in 2026.

The market shake‑up was triggered by William Blair investment‑bank analysts lowering USA Rare Earth’s rating. In a Monday report the analysts said the company is facing raw‑material shortages that pressure the stock, so they cut the rating to a neutral level and revised revenue and profit forecasts accordingly.

USA Rare Earth’s shares plunged 12.6% on Monday, hitting the lowest close since April 3, 2025, when the price closed at $6.50. The drop also marked the biggest single‑day percentage decline since June 5, when the stock fell 17%.
Since the start of the year, USA Rare Earth’s stock has fallen about 50%, whereas it rose 15% over the full year of 2025.
Other rare‑earth related stocks also slipped on Monday, including Critical Metals (CRML‑US), MP Materials (MP‑US) and Rare Earths Americas (REA‑US).

William Blair analysts wrote that USA Rare Earth “is gradually building a foundation for significant future growth,” but the recent raw‑material supply shortage adds pressure to a short‑term challenge the company already faces. Rare‑earth raw materials refer to any ore or waste containing rare‑earth elements that can be further processed.
Earlier this year the Trump administration announced an investment and partnership with USA Rare Earth, as the U.S. government views the rare‑earth sector as a matter of national security.

Rare‑earth elements are actually relatively abundant in the crust, but because they rarely occur in pure form, extraction and refining are difficult, which is why they are called “rare earths.” These minerals are widely used in energy, transportation and, of course, artificial‑intelligence industries.
William Blair analysts said, “Given the ongoing impact of raw‑material shortages, we have pushed our revenue and margin forecasts out significantly to 2028.”

The analysts also noted that beyond supply issues, companies typically encounter a range of operational challenges when trying to increase output and scale production, and the broader rare‑earth industry carries wider‑reaching risks.

However, USA Rare Earth still has a favorable condition. The analysts pointed out that the company held over $1 billion in cash as of the end of the quarter ending September 30, enough to ensure ample liquidity next year and even if raw‑material supply problems persist longer.

items.title: Anthropic CEO示警AI算力投資難題！已承諾砸9,000億美元
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO Warns of AI Computing Investment Challenges! Promises to Spend $900 Billion
paras: Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）坦言，隨著人工智慧（AI）產業快速成長，公司在採購運算資源時面臨高度不確定性，必須精準預測未來數年的需求，避免投入過多資金卻無法轉化為營收，或因算力不足而無法滿足客戶需求、推進新模型研發。
根據《Business Insider》報導，阿莫戴近日在一場直播中與摩根大通執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）對談，討論Anthropic即將進行的首次公開募股（IPO）。Anthropic目標估值達1.4兆美元，預計本周四（19日）掛牌交易。
阿莫戴指出，AI技術進步速度極快，但技術發展究竟能以多快的速度轉化為商業價值，目前仍難以預測，使公司在規劃未來算力需求時面臨重大挑戰。他表示，這項工作會隨時間變得更加棘手，因為每年的相關成本都愈來愈高。
Anthropic在IPO公開說明書中揭露，已承諾投入約9,000億美元進行基礎設施投資，其中約一半須在2030年前支付。
阿莫戴表示，如果公司採購的運算資源超過實際需求，成本可能大幅領先營收，形成沉重負擔；但若投資不足，則可能無法提供客戶所需的AI服務，也會影響下一代AI模型的研發。
他坦言，這是一項「非常困難的問題」。
面對算力需求難以預測的問題，阿莫戴表示，Anthropic將根據新產品及Claude Code等熱門產品的成長動能，盡可能準確評估未來需求。
他也提出兩項緩衝機制，協助公司因應算力需求的不確定性。首先是毛利率。阿莫戴肯定公司能從每單位運算資源創造可觀收益，而分析師也將毛利率視為評估Anthropic營運實力的重要指標之一。
第二項則是充裕的現金部位。根據IPO公開說明書，截至9月30日，Anthropic持有超過950億美元的現金及約當現金，另有360億美元短期投資。此次IPO也將為公司帶來數十億美元資金。
阿莫戴表示，Anthropic的策略是事先採購「相對少量」的算力，即使需求低於預期，也能讓公司處於較有利的位置。如果需求高於預期，公司則有足夠現金，可透過現貨市場即時採購算力，作為短期應急方案。
他對此表示，即使業務發展一度不如預期，公司也有足夠的資源支應，能夠有效降低風險。
Anthropic預計周三（18日）訂定IPO價格，並於周四開始掛牌交易。
paras_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei admitted that as the AI industry grows rapidly, the company faces high uncertainty when procuring computing resources, needing to accurately forecast demand for the next few years to avoid overinvesting without revenue conversion or underinvesting and failing to meet customer needs and model development.

According to Business Insider, Amodei recently discussed Anthropic’s upcoming IPO with JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon in a live broadcast, with a target valuation of $1.4 trillion and a planned listing on Thursday the 19th.

Amodei noted that AI technology advances quickly, but how fast it translates into commercial value remains unpredictable, creating major challenges for planning future computing needs, and that this task will become more difficult as annual costs rise.
In its IPO prospectus, Anthropic disclosed a commitment to invest roughly $900 billion in infrastructure, about half of which must be paid before 2030.

Amodei said that if the company procures more computing resources than needed, costs could far outpace revenue, creating a heavy burden; conversely, insufficient investment could prevent delivering required AI services and hamper next‑generation model development.
He admitted that this is a "very difficult problem."

To address the unpredictable computing demand, Amodei said Anthropic will evaluate future needs as accurately as possible based on growth momentum from new products and popular offerings like Claude Code.

He outlined two buffer mechanisms to manage uncertainty. First, gross margin: Amodei affirmed the company can generate substantial revenue per unit of computing resource, and analysts view gross margin as a key indicator of Anthropic’s operational strength.

Second, ample cash reserves: as of September 30, the IPO prospectus shows Anthropic holding over $95 billion in cash and cash equivalents, plus $36 billion in short‑term investments, and the IPO will bring in billions more.

Amodei explained that Anthropic’s strategy is to pre‑purchase a "relatively small" amount of computing power, positioning the company favorably if demand falls short, while having sufficient cash to buy power on the spot market as a short‑term contingency if demand exceeds expectations.
He added that even if business growth lags, the company has enough resources to support it and effectively reduce risk.
Anthropic plans to set its IPO price on Wednesday the 18th and begin trading on Thursday.

items.title: 輝達股價自高點崩跌35%！空頭帳面大賺240億美元 散戶趁低點創紀錄搶進
items.title_en: NVIDIA Stock Plummets 35% From Peak! Short Sellers Net $24 Billion on Paper While Retail Investors Rush In at Record Low
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳離任後，股價隨相關醜聞發酵而大幅下挫，目前已自歷史高點回跌35%，放空者的帳面獲利預估達到240億美元。同一時間，散戶則趁低買進。
輝達股價上周創下美國總統川普2025年4月「解放日」關稅措施宣布以來最大單周跌幅之後，周一再下挫4.1%。
Integrity資產管理公司投資組合經理Joe Gilbert說：「先前高度看好輝達的持股者可能試圖保住獲利，因此股價仍可能進一步下跌。黃仁勳離開後，公司出現了願景真空。」

空頭趁勢加碼 放空部位達460億美元

黃仁勳因與下屬以及一名疑為中國間諜的女子發生婚外情而遭董事會調查並撤換，是導致輝達股價暴跌的主因。但在此事發生前，科技股已經陷入動盪一段時間，主因是市場擔憂資本密集的人工智慧(AI)基建投資無法持續，而美國期中選舉之後，部分當選候選人承諾將反對資料中心快速擴張，更讓投資人繃緊神經。
根據S3 Partners數據，11月初輝達賣壓加劇之際，逆勢交易者加碼放空押注。放空餘額是衡量市場看空情緒的指標，目前放空餘額約占輝達流通在外股數的1.22%，名目價值約460億美元。

散戶趁低點進場 單周買進20億美元創紀錄

在股價重挫之際，部分投資人開始進場逢低買進。市場數據與研究公司Vanda的資料顯示，散戶上周在輝達股價遭遇賣壓期間，買進金額達到創紀錄的20億美元。
Roundhill Financial執行長Dave Mazza說：「輝達已從市場寵兒變成市場棄兒，這種評價重置正是目前值得關注的原因。看空聲浪很大，但散戶正在進場，除了最糟糕的情境外，無論採取哪種情境評估，這檔股票的估值倍數都具有吸引力。這是趁市場恐慌買進的機會，而不是利多出盡後賣出的時機。」
輝達下一個可能的股價催化劑，是預定周二美股收盤後公布的財報。
晨星投資服務(Morningstar Investment Services)股票策略師Brian Colello說：「我們認為輝達將如過去許多季一樣，公布優於市場預期的業績並上修財測。畢竟，這起事件是在第3季帳目結算後才發生的。」
不過他也指出：「如果輝達真的出現問題，或第3季期間就已經出現問題，而公司在財報中揭露這些情況，將對股價造成非常大的衝擊。」
paras_en: After former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, NVIDIA (NVDA-US) saw its share price tumble dramatically as related scandals unfolded, now down 35% from its historic high, with short sellers’ paper gains estimated at $24 billion. At the same time, retail investors are buying at the lows.
NVIDIA’s stock posted the biggest weekly decline since President Trump announced the April 2025 “Liberation Day” tariff measures, and on Monday it fell another 4.1%.

Joe Gilbert, portfolio manager at Integrity Asset Management, said: “Investors who were previously very bullish on NVIDIA may try to lock in profits, so the stock could fall further. Huang’s departure has left a vision vacuum at the company.”

Short sellers are adding to the trend, with short positions now totalling $46 billion. Huang was investigated and removed by the board over an alleged affair with a subordinate and a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, which sparked the stock’s plunge. Even before that, tech stocks had been volatile as investors worried that capital‑intensive AI infrastructure spending might not be sustainable, and after the U.S. midterm elections some winning candidates pledged to curb rapid data‑center expansion, tightening nerves further.

According to S3 Partners data, as selling pressure on NVIDIA intensified in early November, contrarian traders increased their short bets. The short‑interest ratio, a gauge of bearish sentiment, now stands at about 1.22% of NVIDIA’s float, representing a notional value of roughly $46 billion.

Retail investors are buying at the dip, setting a record by purchasing $2 billion worth of shares in a single week. As the stock slumped, some investors stepped in to buy low. Market data and research firm Vanda show that retail investors spent a record $2 billion buying NVIDIA shares last week amid the selling pressure.

Dave Mazza, CEO of Roundhill Financial, said: “NVIDIA has gone from market darling to market outcast, and this valuation reset is the key story right now. Bearish sentiment is strong, but retail investors are coming in; aside from the worst‑case scenario, the stock’s valuation multiples remain attractive under any scenario. This is a buying opportunity driven by market fear, not a time to sell after all the good news has been priced in.”
The next possible catalyst for NVIDIA’s share price is its earnings report scheduled for release after the U.S. market close on Tuesday.

Brian Colello, stock strategist at Morningstar Investment Services, said: “We expect NVIDIA, as in many past quarters, to report results that beat market expectations and to raise its guidance. After all, this episode occurred after the Q3 close.”
He added: “If NVIDIA does have a problem, or if issues emerged during Q3 and the company discloses them in the earnings report, the impact on the stock could be huge.”

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞財報前續抱輝達賣權 「短期內再便宜都不買！」
items.title_en: "The Big Short" Investor Burry Holds Nvidia Put Options Ahead of Earnings, Says He Won’t Buy Even If It Gets Cheaper
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 將於美東時間週二 (17 日) 公布財報，這是共同創辦人黃仁勳卸任後的首場財報會議。因電影《大賣空》聞名的投資人貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 表示，即使輝達股價繼續下跌，短期內無論跌到什麼價位，他都不會買進。他仍持有明年 2 月到期的輝達賣權，但也坦言，散戶買盤「很有可能」在短期內推升股價。
黃仁勳在媒體披露婚外情後，於上週四 (12 日) 辭去輝達總裁、執行長及董事職務。輝達 (NVDA-US) 週一下跌 4.12% 至每股 156.14 美元，今年以來已累計跌幅達17.32%。
財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 將在董事會尋找正式接班人期間兼任代理執行長，並首度以代理執行長身分主持財報電話會議。
輝達先前預估，本季營收為 1,080 億美元，上下浮動 2%，財測假設中國資料中心運算業務的營收為零。
貝瑞上週日 (15 日) 在 Substack 發文表示：「短期內，無論價格如何，我都不會買入這檔股票 (輝達)，我的直覺告訴我，事情還有不對勁的地方。我擔心輝達還有一些真正的問題會浮上檯面。」
他關注輝達對供應商做出的採購承諾、公司建立的軟硬體生態系能否維持，以及輝達在 AI 投資熱潮中居於核心地位，一旦需求放緩將承受多大衝擊。
貝瑞盯客戶壓價與延後採購
貝瑞表示，他正觀察競爭對手和客戶是否會趁輝達高層交接之際採取行動，尤其是客戶是否會要求更低的晶片價格，或把採購時程往後延。若客戶成功壓價，輝達的利潤率恐承壓。
若客戶等到資料中心接近完工才下單，輝達也可能更難像過去一樣提前數月敲定交易。輝達未立即回應置評請求。
貝瑞過去一年多次質疑 AI 需求背後的融資安排。
他認為，輝達一方面大舉投資 AI 公司，一方面資助客戶採購自家晶片，一旦產業投資降溫，公司可能同時面臨訂單放緩及投資部位承壓。
他也點名輝達在 2025 年底調整營收的地區歸類方式，從依帳單或發票地址統計，改為依客戶的區域總部所在地認列。貝瑞認為，這使外界更難從財報判斷晶片最終在哪裡安裝及使用。
續抱輝達賣權 加碼要看價格
貝瑞表示，他仍持有 2027 年 2 月到期的輝達賣權。被問及是否加碼時，他說要看能以多低的價格買到，並認為之後可能出現更好的進場時機。
他曾考慮在財報前採取跨式策略，同時買進履約價及到期日相同的買權與賣權，押注股價在財報後大幅波動，但認為當時的隱含波動率可能過高，推升了選擇權成本。
他的空頭部位也涵蓋那斯達克 100 指數、VanEck 半導體 ETF (SMH-US)、大都會人壽 (MET-US) 和 Palantir (PLTR-US)。他在週一 (16 日) 的部落格文章中表示，已趁股價持續下探時出清甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 賣權，並平掉最後一部分開拓重工 (CAT-US) 賣權。
貝瑞 9 月將輝達、Palantir 等個股的直接放空部位改為賣權。
到了 10 月，空頭曝險主要集中在 2027 年 4 月到期的那斯達克 100 指數賣權，以及同年 6 月到期的 SMH 賣權。輝達是 SMH 最大持股。
本月稍早，SMH 下跌約 11% 後，貝瑞賣出約四分之一的相關賣權，一週後再買回部分部位，並趁那斯達克 100 指數自約 27,000 點反彈時，將指數賣權部位增至原先的兩倍。
馬斯克憂握手協議生變 分析師緊盯下一輪產能談判
馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 上週六 (14 日) 在社群平台 X 表示，輝達許多交易靠黃仁勳握手拍板，沒有簽署書面合約。黃仁勳卸任後，他認為至少有部分關鍵交易可能流失。
研究機構 Moor Insights & Strategy 分析師 Patrick Moorhead 則表示，有幾家輝達大客戶的執行長曾告訴他，黃仁勳能在會議現場拍板數十億美元的承諾。
他推測，供應商也見識過黃仁勳同樣的決策速度。不過，他認為外界高估了最大幾筆既有交易的風險，因為這些交易已有書面協議。
輝達揭露，截至 7 月 26 日，供應與產能承諾增加至 2,790 億美元，高於前一季的 1,190 億美元，主要用於確保記憶體及製造產能。其中 2,670 億美元的承諾預計在 2029 會計年度結束前履行，部分協議在輝達正式下單前仍可調整或取消。
Moorhead 表示，輝達至少未來 18 個月的供應與產品計畫大致底定，克雷斯也已致電供應商穩定合作關係。他更關注下一輪談判。如果輝達需要更長時間才能拍板，競爭對手就有機會先搶下原本可能由黃仁勳當場敲定的產能。
黃仁勳卸任後 對中晶片政策也成焦點
半導體研究機構 SemiAnalysis 創辦人 Dylan Patel 在 ChinaTalk 播客上表示，失去黃仁勳後，「輝達會是一家弱得多的公司」。他認為，黃仁勳卸任也讓美國產業界在華府討論中國企業可以取得多少美國算力時，少了一個有影響力的聲音。
Patel 指出，中國企業希望取得美國晶片，美國伺服器業者也仰賴中國零組件。
他說，輝達最大的印刷電路板供應商就是一家中國企業。若華府全面切斷中國取得先進晶片的管道，包括限制中國企業在海外租用算力，北京可能反過來限制輝達、谷歌和亞馬遜伺服器所需的零組件出口。
美國國會兩黨已有議員推動收緊對中晶片出口限制。
克雷斯週二首度以代理執行長身分面對分析師，除了營收能否達到 1,080 億美元的財測中值，市場也將關注黃仁勳過去能當場拍板的數十億美元採購與產能承諾，接下來將由誰決定。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) will release its earnings on Tuesday, the 17th, Eastern Time, marking the first earnings call since co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down. Investor Michael Burry, made famous by the film "The Big Short," said that even if Nvidia’s share price keeps falling, he will not buy the stock at any price in the short term. He still holds Nvidia put options expiring in February 2027, but admits that retail buying could "very likely" lift the price in the near term.

After media reports of an extramarital affair, Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s president, CEO and director last Thursday, the 12th. Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell 4.12% on Monday to $156.14 per share, down 17.32% year‑to‑date.
Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, and will chair the earnings call in her interim capacity for the first time.
Nvidia previously projected Q2 revenue of $108 billion, plus or minus 2%, assuming zero revenue from its China data‑center computing business.

Burry wrote on Substack last Sunday, the 15th: "In the short term, no matter the price, I will not buy Nvidia stock. My gut tells me something still isn’t right. I’m worried that real problems at Nvidia will surface."

He is watching Nvidia’s procurement commitments to suppliers, whether its hardware‑software ecosystem can be sustained, and how much impact a slowdown in AI demand would have on a company that sits at the centre of the AI investment boom.
Burry watches customers pressuring prices and delaying purchases

Burry says he is watching whether rivals and customers will act during Nvidia’s leadership transition, especially if customers demand lower chip prices or push back procurement schedules. If customers succeed in price‑pressuring, Nvidia’s margins could be squeezed.

If customers wait until data‑center construction is near completion before ordering, Nvidia may find it harder to lock in deals months in advance as it has in the past. Nvidia did not immediately respond to comment requests.
Over the past year Burry has repeatedly questioned the financing behind AI demand.

He believes Nvidia is simultaneously pouring money into AI firms and subsidising customers to buy its chips; a cooling of industry investment could hit both order flow and Nvidia’s own investment positions.

He also called out Nvidia’s change in revenue geography reporting slated for the end of 2025, shifting from billing‑address or invoice‑address accounting to recognizing revenue based on the customer’s regional headquarters. Burry says this makes it harder for outsiders to tell where chips are ultimately installed and used from the financial statements.
Continuing to hold Nvidia puts, adding more depends on price

Burry says he still holds Nvidia put options expiring in February 2027. When asked if he would add to the position, he said it depends on how low he can buy them and that a better entry point may appear later.

He once considered a straddle before the earnings release—buying calls and puts with the same strike and expiry to bet on a big post‑earnings move—but felt the implied volatility was too high at the time, inflating option costs.

His short positions also include the Nasdaq‑100 index, VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US), MetLife (MET‑US) and Palantir (PLTR‑US). In a blog post on Monday the 16th he said he had sold his Oracle (ORCL‑US) puts as the stock kept falling and had closed the last of his Caterpillar (CAT‑US) put exposure.
In September Burry switched his outright short positions in Nvidia, Palantir and other stocks to put options.
By October his short exposure was mainly concentrated in Nasdaq‑100 puts expiring April 2027 and SMH puts expiring June 2027. Nvidia is SMH’s largest holding.

Earlier this month, after SMH fell about 11%, Burry sold roughly a quarter of the related puts, bought back part of the position a week later, and doubled his Nasdaq‑100 put exposure when the index rebounded from around 27,000 points.
Musk worries a handshake deal could fall apart; analysts watch the next capacity negotiations

Elon Musk said on X last Saturday the 14th that many Nvidia deals were sealed by Jensen Huang’s handshake, without written contracts. With Huang out, Musk thinks at least some key deals could be lost.
Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Patrick Moorhead said several CEOs of Nvidia’s biggest customers told him that Huang could make multi‑billion‑dollar commitments on the spot during meetings.
He speculates that suppliers have also seen Huang’s rapid decision‑making, but believes the market overestimates the risk to the biggest existing deals because they already have written agreements.

Nvidia disclosed that as of July 26, supply and capacity commitments rose to $279 billion, up from $119 billion in the prior quarter, mainly to secure memory and manufacturing capacity. About $267 billion of those commitments are expected to be fulfilled by the end of fiscal 2029, and some agreements can still be adjusted or cancelled before Nvidia formally places orders.

Moorhead said Nvidia’s supply and product plans for at least the next 18 months are basically set, and Kress has already called suppliers to stabilise relationships. He is more focused on the next round of negotiations: if Nvidia needs longer to seal deals, rivals could snap up capacity that Huang would have closed on the spot.
After Huang’s departure, China chip policy also becomes a focus

Dylan Patel, founder of semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis, said on the ChinaTalk podcast that without Huang, "Nvidia would be a much weaker company." He believes Huang’s exit also removes an influential voice from U.S. industry discussions in Washington about how much computing power Chinese firms can obtain from the United States.
Patel noted that Chinese companies want U.S. chips and U.S. server makers also rely on Chinese components.

He said Nvidia’s biggest printed‑circuit‑board supplier is a Chinese firm. If Washington were to completely cut off China’s access to advanced chips—including restricting Chinese firms from renting overseas compute power—Beijing might retaliate by limiting exports of the components needed for Nvidia, Google and Amazon servers.
Both parties in the U.S. Congress have members pushing to tighten export restrictions on chips to China.

Kress will appear as interim CEO for the first time on Tuesday, and analysts will watch not only whether revenue hits the mid‑point of the $108 billion forecast, but also who will make the on‑the‑spot multi‑billion‑dollar procurement and capacity commitments that Jensen Huang used to decide in person.

items.title: 美股反彈避險基金反而加碼放空！科技股多空比創10年新低、高盛揭市場矛盾
paras: 美股科技股上周強勢反彈，費城半導體指數單周漲幅超過8%，創4月以來最佳表現，但避險基金並未因此轉向積極布局，反而加碼放空個股，科技股配置更是降至歷史低點，雖然這種情況可能為後續軋空行情創造條件，但基金仍在趁反彈放空個股，顯示市場對這波漲勢是否能持續仍缺乏共識。
根據高盛Prime Brokerage最新周報，截至上周四，避險基金已連續第二周淨賣出美股，但賣出方式出現變化。再前一周主要是多頭部位平倉，上週則以建立新的個股空頭為主，顯示基金趁著晶片股強勢反彈，進一步押注個股下跌。
同期標普500指數上漲2.5%，費城半導體指數更大漲逾8%。不過，選股型基金的表現明顯落後，標普500單周報酬率達3.27%，美國選股型基金僅約1.78%，不到指數的一半。
高盛數據也顯示，美國資訊科技類股多空比已降至1.5，創該行2016年開始追蹤以來最低紀錄。相較2026年6月初的高點2.14，五個月內下滑約30%，避險基金對科技股的配置更比標普500低配逾20個百分點。

避險基金撤出個股多頭，轉向建立空頭部位

從整體布局來看，截至上周四，高盛全球主經紀商帳簿中的股票再度遭到淨賣出，賣出程度相當於過去一年分布的負0.7個標準差，去槓桿化速度也有所加快，多頭賣出與空頭回補的比例達2.8比1。
美國市場的資金流向則呈現兩極化。指數與ETF等宏觀產品已連續第三周獲得淨買入，程度達正1.2個標準差；美國上市ETF空頭部位減少8.6%，創七個月來最大降幅，主要集中在大型股、信用及科技ETF。
但個股交易方向正好相反。美國個股遭大幅淨賣出，程度達負1.7個標準差，而且賣壓幾乎全數來自新建立的個股空頭，多頭部位變動相對有限。
換言之，避險基金正在降低指數避險部位，卻同步增加個股放空敞口，與10月的操作方向形成鮮明對比。

科技股多空比創新低 金融股遭遇大舉賣出

產業方面，資訊科技類股仍是全球及美國市場遭淨賣出最多的板塊。
與此同時，金融股則成為另一個主要賣出目標，上周淨賣出程度達負2.2個標準差，買賣雙向交易的賣出比例約為4比1，淨賣出規模居美國各產業之首，在過去五年分布中位於第99百分位。
交易支付處理、資本市場業務（包括投資銀行與資產管理）、消費金融及保險，是金融股主要賣出方向。
值得注意的是，金融股目前仍占高盛主經紀商美國淨曝險的12.1%，處於過去一年分布的第98百分位。
高盛金融股專家Christian DeGrasse指出，金融股上週表現落後標普500約200個基點，防禦型與積極型個股之間並未出現明顯差異，顯示持倉調整是股價走弱的主要原因，其中消費金融股賣壓尤其明顯。
醫療保健類股也連續第四周遭淨賣出，減持速度創七個月來最快，且全部來自多頭部位平倉，主要涉及生技、製藥及醫療服務業者。
高盛醫療保健專家Jon Chan表示，客戶對大型生技製藥公司的估值感到不安，市場上甚至出現輝瑞(PFE-US) 與輝達(NVDA-US) 本益比的比較。當被視為避風港的資產估值，反而高於風險資產時，投資人自然可能轉向其他標的。

總槓桿仍高 淨槓桿卻落在五年低點

避險基金的槓桿數據，也反映出市場布局的矛盾。
美國基本面多空基金淨槓桿率上升2.1個百分點至45.4%，但高盛指出，這波改善幾乎全數來自市場上漲及指數空頭回補，而非基金主動增加多頭部位。
美國選股型基金本月至今總槓桿率下降5.8個百分點，淨槓桿率則減少1.7個百分點，後者仍處於過去五年的第2百分位。
全球避險基金的情況也類似，總槓桿率位於過去五年的第95百分位，但淨槓桿率僅在第3百分位。這代表基金仍維持相當高的整體部位規模，卻沒有明確押注市場方向。
此外，高盛籃子團隊數據顯示，主經紀商帳簿中的動能因子曝險，已從2026年高點回落至過去五年區間的第23百分位；資料中心投資組合的持倉集中程度，更降至過去六個月的第1百分位。這項因子夏季時一度占基金淨資產約60%，目前已不到10%。

多經理人基金10月創紀錄最差表現

避險基金的疲弱不只反映在近期交易，10月績效也相當慘淡。
根據高盛彙整488封避險基金投資人信函的月度績效報告，10月全產業基金平均虧損1.3%，多經理人平台基金則虧損2.3%。高盛形容，這是有紀錄以來最差的單月表現，甚至超越2020年3月。
基本面多空基金10月虧損3.49%，系統性多空基金（量化策略）虧損3.6%，也是高盛自2016年開始追蹤以來，這兩類策略首次在同一個月同時虧損超過3%。
從全年表現來看，多經理人平台基金年初至今僅獲利0.1%，多策略基金獲利1.2%，信用策略基金獲利1.7%；同期標普500指數上漲11.8%，羅素2000指數則上漲14.4%。
高盛科技、媒體與電信（TMT）首席專家Peter Callahan表示，上週市場反彈很大程度上是持倉調整及產業內部輪動的結果。他指出，市場目前出現相當長一段時間以來最缺乏共識的局面，這或許反而能成為邁向2027年較健康的投資起點。

持倉出清能否為美股帶來新一波漲勢？

市場多頭認為，避險基金已大幅降低淨槓桿，動能交易的擁擠部位也經過調整，意味著較弱勢的投資人已經離場，市場有機會迎來新一波上漲。
摩根士丹利估算，當其追蹤的美國多空基金淨槓桿率處於目前這種低檔水準時，標普500指數未來三個月平均報酬率約6.3%，未來12個月平均報酬率約20.7%，約為一般情況的兩倍。
高盛宏觀交易團隊也認為，經歷過去10年來最激進的去風險化過程之一後，年底市場具備軋空上漲的條件。
不過，避險基金的實際操作仍透露出謹慎態度。高盛衍生品團隊指出，過去10個交易日，VIX看跌期權成交量超越2026年此前任何時段，顯示投資人對波動率下降的信心，甚至高於對現貨市場上漲的預期。
費城半導體指數上周一單日大漲6.85%，顯示在淨槓桿偏低、空頭部位相對集中的情況下，市場仍具備向上急漲的潛力。
然而，市場具備上漲條件，不代表投資人已準備好進場買進。
即使美股上周強勢反彈，科技股多空比降至歷史低點，避險基金仍選擇增加個股空頭部位，市場能否將持倉調整轉化為持續買盤，仍是後續行情的重要觀察指標。

items.title: 波克夏13F出爐！連九季減碼美銀 Lennar持股近翻倍、新建倉Bending Spoons
items.title_en: Berkshire Hathaway 13F Released! Ninth Consecutive Quarter Cutting Bank of America, Lennar Stake Nearly Doubles, New Position in Bending Spoons
paras: 波克夏海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 週一 (16 日) 公布第三季 13F 持股申報，連續第九季減碼美國銀行 (BAC-US)，並將 Capital One Financial (COF-US) 持股砍逾六成。加碼方面，波克夏持有的美國住宅建商 Lennar (LEN-US) A 類股近乎翻倍，增至約 2,603 萬股，並揭露新建倉義大利軟體公司 Bending Spoons (BSP-US)。
截至 9 月底，波克夏在 13F 申報中揭露的持股市值約為 3,042 億美元，占其整體 3,355 億美元股票投資組合的大部分。波克夏本月稍早公布的第三季 10-Q 財報顯示，當季買進約 24 億美元股票、賣出約 28 億美元，淨賣出約 4 億美元。
美國銀行再減約 2,750 萬股 Capital One 持股砍逾六成
波克夏第三季減持約 2,750 萬股美國銀行股票，持股季減約 5.7%，降至約 4.559 億股。
波克夏第二季已減持約 3,000 萬股，當時持股降至約 4.834 億股。
相較 2024 年中逾 10 億股的水準，波克夏目前持股已縮減逾半。前執行長巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 尚未公開說明連續減碼的原因。
13F 出爐前指出，波克夏第三季財報顯示，金融類股投資的成本基礎下降，同期也認列部分股票投資處分利益，這些跡象讓外界推測波克夏可能再度減持美國銀行。
Capital One 也連續兩季遭大幅減碼。
波克夏第二季已賣出約 400 萬股，將持股降至 300 萬股，第三季再賣出約 185 萬股，減幅約 62%，期末持股剩約 115 萬股。
Lennar A 類股近翻倍 Bending Spoons 首度入列
波克夏第三季增持近 1,292 萬股 Lennar A 類股，持股由 6 月底的 1,311 萬股增至 9 月底的 2,603 萬股，季增 98.6%。
以 Lennar 9 月 30 日收盤價 81.59 美元計算，新增的 A 類股市值約 10.5 億美元，是這季按金額計算加碼最多的標的。
這也是波克夏連續第二季加碼 Lennar。相較 3 月底約 1,010 萬股，波克夏持有的 Lennar A 類股半年增加約 158%。同一季，Lennar B 類股也從約 29.8 萬股增至 55.3 萬股。
兩類股票合計季末市值約 21.7 億美元，占 13F 揭露持股市值約 0.7%。
另外兩檔住宅建商 NVR (NVR-US) 與 D.R. Horton (DHI-US) 的持股股數則維持不變。
波克夏第三季也新建倉 Bending Spoons，截至 9 月底持有約 2,069 萬股。
這家擁有 AOL 和 Vimeo 的義大利軟體公司先前透露，波克夏在 7 月首次公開募股 (IPO) 時投入 6 億美元，並在 10 月再投入 3.3 億美元，將持股比例提高至約 4%。
其他持股方面，波克夏第三季加碼達美航空 (DAL-US)，Alphabet 持股股數維持不變。截至 9 月底，蘋果、美國運通、可口可樂、Alphabet 與美國銀行仍是 13F 揭露的前五大持股，合計占申報持股市值約 68%。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) disclosed its third‑quarter 13F filing on Monday the 16th, marking the ninth straight quarter of reducing its Bank of America (BAC-US) stake and slashing its Capital One Financial (COF-US) holding by more than 60%. On the buying side, Berkshire’s position in U.S. homebuilder Lennar (LEN-US) Class A shares almost doubled, rising to about 26.03 million shares, and it disclosed a new position in Italian software firm Bending Spoons (BSP-US).

As of the end of September, the market value of the holdings reported in Berkshire’s 13F was roughly $304.2 billion, representing the bulk of its total $335.5 billion equity portfolio. Berkshire’s third‑quarter 10‑Q, released earlier this month, showed purchases of about $2.4 billion in stocks and sales of about $2.8 billion, a net sale of roughly $0.4 billion.
Bank of America reduced by about 27.5 million shares; Capital One stake cut by more than 60%
In the third quarter Berkshire sold about 27.5 million Bank of America shares, a quarterly decline of roughly 5.7% to about 455.9 million shares.
In the second quarter Berkshire had sold about 30 million shares, bringing its holding down to roughly 483.4 million shares.

Compared with the more than 1 billion‑share level in mid‑2024, Berkshire’s current stake is now down by more than half. Former CEO Warren Buffett has not publicly explained the consecutive reductions.

Ahead of the 13F release, Berkshire’s third‑quarter report showed that the cost basis of its financial‑sector investments fell and that it recognized some gains from stock disposals, leading observers to speculate that Berkshire might further trim its Bank of America position.
Capital One also saw large reductions for two consecutive quarters.

In the second quarter Berkshire sold about 4 million Capital One shares, lowering its holding to 3 million shares; in the third quarter it sold another roughly 1.85 million shares, a 62% drop, leaving about 1.15 million shares at quarter‑end.
Lennar Class A shares nearly double; Bending Spoons added for the first time

In the third quarter Berkshire added roughly 12.92 million Lennar Class A shares, increasing its stake from 13.11 million shares at the end of June to 26.03 million shares at the end of September, a quarterly gain of 98.6%.
Using Lennar’s September 30 closing price of $81.59, the new Class A shares are valued at about $1.05 billion, making Lennar the largest dollar‑value addition in the quarter.

This is Berkshire’s second consecutive quarter adding to Lennar. Compared with roughly 10.1 million shares at the end of March, the Class A stake grew about 158% over six months. In the same quarter, Lennar Class B shares also rose from about 298,000 to 553,000 shares.
Combined, the two classes were worth about $2.17 billion at quarter‑end, roughly 0.7% of the total market value disclosed in the 13F.
The share counts for the other two homebuilders, NVR (NVR-US) and D.R. Horton (DHI-US), remained unchanged.
Berkshire also opened a new position in Bending Spoons in the third quarter, holding about 20.69 million shares as of the end of September.
The Italian software company, which owns AOL and Vimeo, previously disclosed that Berkshire invested $600 million in its July IPO and another $330 million in October, raising its stake to about 4%.

Other holdings: Berkshire added Delta Air Lines (DAL-US) in the third quarter, while its Alphabet position stayed flat. As of the end of September, Apple, American Express, Coca‑Cola, Alphabet and Bank of America remained the top five holdings in the 13F, together accounting for roughly 68% of the disclosed portfolio value.

items.title: 〈分析〉董事會不理近18萬連署 輝達法說沒有黃仁勳的三大差別
items.title_en: Analysis: Board Ignores Nearly 180,000 Signatures; Nvidia Earnings Call Lacks Jensen Huang's Three Key Differences
paras: 財報公布前夕，要求黃仁勳回任的網路連署已累積近18萬人，美國總統川普周一(16日)也表示不反對。
不過，《CNBC》周一引述知情人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US)董事會目前未考慮或討論讓黃仁勳回任，現階段重心仍是針對他的調查。
輝達已聘請Wachtell Lipton律師事務所，調查黃仁勳的行為是否危及美國國家安全，或造成公司機密外洩。
輝達將於美東時間周二(17日)盤後公布第三季財報，法說會訂於美西時間下午2時舉行，換算台北時間為周三(18日)清晨6時。
本季於10月25日結束，黃仁勳上周四才辭任執行長，整季營運均在他任內進行。《CNBC》指出，這場法說會將由臨時執行長、財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)主持。
《路透社》指出，黃仁勳突然離任，使財報焦點從毛利率與現金運用等既有議題，轉向輝達對整個AI生態系的影響力。
Synovus Trust投資組合經理Dan Morgan預期，輝達第三季營收可能比市場共識約1,090.8億美元高出20億至30億美元，年增率將超過九成。
但Morgan也向《路透社》表示，本周最大的問題是輝達要如何消除不確定性，讓股價突破目前的交易區間。

差別一：遠期展望的說服力

資產管理公司Marlborough駐倫敦股票投資組合經理Rory Dowie上周已出清輝達持股。他認為，黃仁勳離開使輝達獲利面臨更大風險。
Dowie表示，Marlborough傾向布局準備搶占輝達市占的公司；黃仁勳離任，可能讓超微(AMD-US)或博通(AVGO-US)等競爭者更有機會。
輝達股價已從10月高點回落約三分之一。SilverSea資產管理避險基金經理人Max Anderl提醒，估值收縮並非全由黃仁勳離任造成。
Anderl估計，輝達獲利中近三分之一屬非營業項目，來自股權投資評價利益。他指出，若AI產業前景改變，相關投資可能減記，市場成長預期也可能逆轉。
他認為，即使輝達財報持續亮眼，本益比也早在執行長離任前開始收縮。

差別二：法說會上少了他的答問

《CNBC》描述，過往法說會由克瑞斯依準備好的講稿報告季度業績與展望，之後再由黃仁勳回答分析師問題，從公司技術談到整個AI生態系。
周二的法說會將是克瑞斯首次全程主持。投資人將關注她如何回應執行長交接、接班人遴選，以及公司文化與技術領先能否延續等問題。

差別三：他個人撐起的交易號召力

《CNBC》指出，黃仁勳深度介入晶片分配，決定客戶取得供貨的先後順序，也親自推動以輝達資產負債表支持大型資料中心融資。
他8月曾在《CNBC》宣布與六家大型金融機構合作，協助新雲業者(neocloud)及前沿AI實驗室取得融資。
《CNBC》指出，這項計畫至今尚未完成任何交易。克瑞斯是否具備同等的華爾街號召力，或願意繼續動用資產負債表推動晶片銷售，仍有待觀察。
《CNBC》引述輝達最新申報文件報導，公司已承諾的供應與產能支出，本會計年度剩餘期間為920億美元，截至2028年1月的年度為870億美元，2029年度為880億美元。
周三清晨的法說會，首先要看成長展望。《CNBC》報導，克瑞斯在上次法說會預估2028會計年度營收成長約七成，並形容這是「供應受限下的展望」。
其次是中國業務與華府調查。參議員Wyden與眾議員Neal正調查輝達對中晶片銷售的核准過程。
美國財政部長貝森特上周五接受《CNBC》訪問時則問：「真正的故事應該是，輝達到底認不認識自己的客戶？」
最後，市場將檢視克瑞斯首次以臨時執行長身分主持法說，能否在黃仁勳之外建立說服力。這場財報不只反映季度業績，也將讓投資人評估輝達的領導交接、供應承諾與AI產業角色。
paras_en: On the eve of its earnings release, an online petition calling for Jensen Huang's return has amassed nearly 180,000 signatures, and U.S. President Trump also said on Monday (the 16th) that he does not oppose it.
However, CNBC reported on Monday that Nvidia (NVDA-US) board members are currently not considering or discussing Huang's reinstatement; their focus remains on the investigation into him.
Nvidia has hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to probe whether Huang's actions jeopardize U.S. national security or cause leakage of company secrets.

Nvidia will release its third‑quarter results after the market close on Tuesday, Oct. 17 (U.S. Eastern Time), with the earnings call scheduled for 2 p.m. Pacific Time, which is 6 a.m. Wednesday morning in Taipei.

The quarter ended on Oct. 25; Huang stepped down as CEO only last Thursday, so the entire quarter’s operations were conducted under his leadership. CNBC noted that the call will be hosted by interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress.
Reuters pointed out that Huang’s sudden departure shifted the earnings focus from existing topics such as gross margin and cash usage to Nvidia’s influence over the broader AI ecosystem.
Synovus Trust portfolio manager Dan Morgan expects Nvidia’s Q3 revenue could exceed the consensus of about $109.08 billion by $2‑3 billion, implying a year‑over‑year growth rate of over 90%.
Morgan also told Reuters that the biggest issue this week is how Nvidia can eliminate uncertainty and push the stock price out of its current trading range.

Difference 1: Persuasiveness of forward outlook. Marlborough’s London‑based equity portfolio manager Rory Dowie sold his Nvidia position last week, believing Huang’s exit raises profit risks for the company.
Dowie said Marlborough is positioning to back companies that could capture Nvidia’s market share; with Huang gone, rivals such as AMD (AMD-US) or Broadcom (AVGO-US) may have a better chance.

Nvidia’s share price has fallen roughly one‑third from its October peak. Max Anderl, a hedge‑fund manager at SilverSea Asset Management, cautioned that the valuation contraction is not solely due to Huang’s departure.

Anderl estimates that nearly one‑third of Nvidia’s earnings come from non‑operating items, mainly gains from equity‑investment valuations. He warned that if the AI industry outlook changes, those investments could be written down and growth expectations could reverse.
He believes that even if Nvidia’s earnings remain strong, the price‑to‑earnings multiple began compressing before the CEO’s exit.

Difference 2: The earnings call will lack his Q&A. CNBC described that past calls featured Kress delivering a prepared script on quarterly results and outlook, followed by Huang fielding analysts’ questions about technology and the AI ecosystem.

Tuesday’s call will be Kress’s first time hosting the entire session. Investors will watch how she addresses the CEO transition, succession selection, and whether the company’s culture and tech leadership can endure.

Difference 3: His personal deal‑making clout. CNBC noted that Huang was deeply involved in chip allocation, deciding the order in which customers received supply, and personally used Nvidia’s balance sheet to finance large data‑center projects.
In August, he announced on CNBC a partnership with six major financial institutions to help new cloud providers (neocloud) and frontier AI labs obtain financing.

CNBC said the program has not yet completed any transactions. It remains to be seen whether Kress has comparable Wall Street charisma or will continue to leverage the balance sheet to drive chip sales.

CNBC cited Nvidia’s latest filing, which shows the company has committed supply and capacity spending of $92 billion for the remainder of the current fiscal year, $87 billion for fiscal 2028 and $88 billion for fiscal 2029.

The Wednesday‑morning call will first focus on growth outlook. CNBC reported that Kress previously projected roughly 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028 and described it as a “supply‑constrained outlook.”
Next will be discussion of China business and a Washington investigation. Senators Wyden and Representative Neal are probing Nvidia’s approval process for chip sales to China.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen asked in a CNBC interview last Friday, “The real story is whether Nvidia really knows its customers?”

Finally, the market will assess whether Kress, as interim CEO, can establish credibility beyond Huang. This earnings release not only reflects quarterly performance but also forces investors to evaluate Nvidia’s leadership transition, supply commitments and role in the AI industry.

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任前8個月 逾105億美元輝達股票轉入家族信託
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Transfers Over $10.5 Billion of Nvidia Stock to Family Trust in the Eight Months Before Stepping Down
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 共同創辦人黃仁勳卸下執行長職務前約 8 個月，與妻子洛莉 (Lori Huang) 依十年前訂下的安排，將近 5,900 萬股輝達股票轉入家族不可撤銷信託。《巴隆週刊》根據美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 申報文件估算，這批股票在今年 3 月移轉時市值逾 105 億美元。回到 2016 年，夫婦倆投入這兩筆十年期信託的輝達股票，合計市值約 5,100 萬美元。
SEC 申報顯示，兩筆十年期信託於今年 3 月 18 日如期到期，各移出 29,481,301 股，合計 58,962,602 股，全數轉入黃家不可撤銷剩餘財產信託 (Huang Irrevocable Remainder Trust)。
黃仁勳為該信託受託人，移轉後該信託合計持有約 1.09 億股輝達股票。
黃仁勳與洛莉育有一子一女，兩人均曾在輝達任職。
兒子黃勝斌 (Spencer Huang) 曾擔任機器人產品總監，女兒黃敏珊 (Madison Huang) 曾擔任產品行銷資深總監。
SEC 申報未揭露這筆家族信託的受益人姓名。
《巴隆週刊》向輝達及黃家基金會尋求回應，均未獲答覆。
十年前投入 5,100 萬美元 搭上 AI 股價漲勢
2016 年 2 月，輝達仍以遊戲晶片業務為主。
黃仁勳當時在財報電話會議上表示，人工智慧 (AI) 很可能被納入各類應用，這股趨勢已開始擴及不同產業。同年 3 月 16 日，他與妻子以輝達股票設立四筆信託，其中兩筆為四年期，另外兩筆為十年期。
《巴隆週刊》分析 SEC 申報指出，兩筆十年期信託最初投入約 5,100 萬美元的輝達股票，2017 年 5 月合計價值已超過 1.9 億美元，2021 年突破 10 億美元，2023 年 6 月進一步增至約 22.9 億美元。
道瓊市場數據顯示，從信託設立到到期的十年間，輝達股價累計上漲 22,161%，同期標普 500 指數上漲 288%。
波士頓信託與遺產律師 Joshua Caswell 認為，選擇十年期反映黃仁勳對自己和公司有相當大的信心，即使當時難以預料何時能將持股變現。
他表示，自己未曾見過規模達數十億美元的同類案例，並指出這項安排讓夫婦倆移轉的這部分財富免於繳納聯邦遺產稅。
股價漲得越多 可移轉給受益人的資產越多
黃仁勳夫婦採用的是「委託人保留年金信託」(GRAT)。
委託人將股票等資產放入信託，在約定期間內定期領回年金。
以「歸零型」設計為例，年金按美國國稅局 (IRS) 規定的利率折算成現值後，約等於最初投入的資產價值，因而可將設立時的應稅贈與價值降至接近零。
信託到期後，支付完年金所剩的資產可移轉給受益人。信託期間股價漲得越多，通常就有越多資產可供移轉。
曾任遺產律師的 Fidelis Capital 合夥人 Chris Tate 說，GRAT 是美國國稅局認可的財產規劃工具。
若資產報酬低於規定利率，信託到期可能沒有剩餘資產可供移轉，設立人仍須支付法律及行政費用。
若設立人在信託期間身故，部分或全部信託資產也可能被納入應稅遺產。這類信託常見期限為兩年或四年，十年期較少見，因為資產的長期表現更難預測。
三月完成移轉 十一月卸任
這批股票在 3 月依信託約定完成移轉。
到了 11 月，媒體陸續報導黃仁勳多起婚外情，黃仁勳卸下輝達執行長、總裁及董事職務，由財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 代理執行長。
TritonPoint Wealth 執行長 Andrew Schiff 表示，若股價在年金信託到期前下跌，跌勢持續多久、股價能回升多少，都可能大幅影響最終可移轉給受益人的增值。黃家這批股票的逾 105 億美元，是今年 3 月移轉當時的市值。股票轉入家族信託後，價值仍隨輝達股價波動。
paras_en: About eight months before Jensen Huang, co‑founder of Nvidia (NVDA‑US), stepped down as CEO, he and his wife Lori Huang moved roughly 59 million Nvidia shares into an irrevocable family trust under an arrangement they set up ten years ago. According to Bloomberg based on SEC filings, the shares were worth more than $10.5 billion when transferred in March of this year. Back in 2016, the couple had initially placed Nvidia stock worth about $51 million into the two ten‑year trusts.

SEC filings show that the two ten‑year trusts matured on March 18 this year, each releasing 29,481,301 shares for a total of 58,962,602 shares, all of which were transferred into the Huang Irrevocable Remainder Trust.
Jensen Huang serves as trustee of the trust, which now holds approximately 109 million Nvidia shares in total after the transfer.
Jensen and Lori have a son and a daughter, both of whom have previously worked at Nvidia.
Their son, Spencer Huang, previously served as Director of Robotics Products, and their daughter, Madison Huang, was a Senior Director of Product Marketing.
The SEC filing does not disclose the names of the trust’s beneficiaries.
Bloomberg reached out to Nvidia and the Huang Family Foundation for comment and received no response.
Ten years ago they invested $51 million and rode the AI stock surge.
In February 2016 Nvidia was still primarily a gaming‑chip company.

At that time, Huang told analysts on a earnings call that artificial intelligence was likely to be incorporated into many applications and that the trend was already spreading across industries. On March 16 of the same year, he and his wife created four trusts using Nvidia stock—two with four‑year terms and two with ten‑year terms.

Bloomberg’s analysis of the SEC filing notes that the two ten‑year trusts were initially funded with about $51 million of Nvidia stock, which was worth over $190 million by May 2017, broke $1 billion in 2021, and rose to roughly $2.29 billion by June 2023.
According to Dow Jones market data, Nvidia’s share price rose a cumulative 22,161 % over the ten‑year life of the trusts, compared with a 288 % gain for the S&P 500 over the same period.

Boston trust and estate attorney Joshua Caswell said the ten‑year term reflects Huang’s strong confidence in himself and the company, even though it was impossible at the time to predict when the holdings could be liquidated.
He added that he has never seen a comparable case involving tens of billions of dollars, and that the structure allows the portion of wealth transferred by the couple to avoid federal estate tax.
The higher the stock price climbs, the more assets can be passed on to beneficiaries.
The Huangs used a Grantor Retained Annuity Trust (GRAT).
The grantor places assets such as stock into the trust and receives a scheduled annuity payment during the trust term.

With a “zero‑coupon” design, the annuity’s present value—calculated using the IRS‑prescribed interest rate—is roughly equal to the initial asset value, effectively reducing the taxable gift value at creation to near zero.

After the trust term ends and the annuity payments are made, any remaining assets can be transferred to the beneficiaries; the more the stock appreciates during the term, the larger the residual transfer.
Former estate‑lawyer and Fidelis Capital partner Chris Tate explained that GRATs are an IRS‑approved estate‑planning tool.
If the asset’s return falls below the prescribed rate, the trust may have no remaining assets to transfer at termination, and the settlor must still cover legal and administrative costs.

If the settlor dies during the trust term, part or all of the trust assets could be included in the taxable estate. Such trusts are usually set up for two‑ or four‑year terms; ten‑year terms are rare because long‑term performance is harder to predict.
Transfer completed in March; resignation in November.
The shares were transferred in March according to the trust agreement.

By November, media reports surfaced about multiple extramarital affairs involving Huang. He stepped down from his roles as CEO, president and director of Nvidia, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO.

Andrew Schiff, CEO of TritonPoint Wealth, said that if the stock price falls before the annuity trust matures, the duration and depth of the decline—and the subsequent recovery—could dramatically affect the ultimate value transferred to beneficiaries. The Huangs’ stock, valued at over $10.5 billion at the time of the March transfer, continues to fluctuate with Nvidia’s market price after being moved into the family trust.

items.title: 稀土股跌勢加劇！USAR遭降評重挫12% 原料短缺成最新利空
items.title_en: Rare Earth Stocks Accelerate Downward Trend! USAR Slashed 12% After Downgrade, Raw Material Shortage Adds New Headwind
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，華爾街週一(16日)對USA Rare Earth(USAR-US)發布負面評估，引發市場拋售潮，並拖累其他稀土類股同步走跌。這家兼具採礦與製造業務的公司今年以來股價已大幅下挫，與2026年初曾經歷的強勁漲勢形成鮮明對比。
引發市場震盪的關鍵，是投行William Blair分析師調降USA Rare Earth股票評級。分析師週一在報告中指出，公司正面臨原料短缺問題，對股價形成壓力，因此將評級下調至相當於中立的水準，並同步調整營收及獲利預估。
USA Rare Earth股價週一大跌12.6%，創下2025年4月3日以來最低收盤價，當時股價收在6.50美元。跌幅也創下6月5日以來最大單日百分比跌幅，當時該股下跌17%。
今年以來，USA Rare Earth股價已下跌約50%。相較之下，2025年全年股價上漲15%。
其他稀土相關個股週一也同步下挫，包括Critical Metals(CRML-US)、MP Materials(MP-US)及Rare Earths Americas(REA-US)。
William Blair分析師在報告中指出，USA Rare Earth「正逐步建立未來顯著成長的基礎」，但近期原料供應短缺，為公司原本就面臨的短期挑戰再添壓力。稀土原料是指含有稀土元素、且可進一步加工的各類原材料，包括礦石及廢棄物等。
今年稍早，川普政府宣布與USA Rare Earth建立投資及合作關係，因為美國政府將稀土產業視為攸關國家安全的重要領域。
稀土元素在地殼中的含量其實相對豐富，但由於通常不會以純元素形式存在，開採與提煉難度較高，因此被稱為「稀土」。這些礦物廣泛應用於能源、交通運輸，當然也包括人工智慧等產業。
William Blair分析師表示，「考量原料短缺持續造成影響，我們已將營收及利潤率預估大幅延後至2028年。」
分析師也指出，除了原料供應問題外，企業在提高產量、擴大生產規模的過程中，通常還會面臨各種營運挑戰，而整體稀土產業也存在更廣泛的風險。
不過，USA Rare Earth仍有一項有利條件。分析師指出，公司截至9月底一季結束時，持有超過10億美元現金，足以確保公司在明年，甚至原料供應問題持續更久的情況下，仍擁有「充足流動性」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Wall Street on Monday (the 16th) issued a negative assessment of USA Rare Earth (USAR-US), sparking a market sell‑off and dragging other rare‑earth stocks down with it. The mining‑and‑manufacturing company has seen its share price tumble sharply this year, a stark contrast to the strong rally it enjoyed early in 2026.

The market shake‑up was triggered by William Blair investment‑bank analysts lowering USA Rare Earth’s rating. In a Monday report the analysts said the company is facing raw‑material shortages that pressure the stock, so they cut the rating to a neutral level and revised revenue and profit forecasts accordingly.

USA Rare Earth’s shares plunged 12.6% on Monday, hitting the lowest close since April 3, 2025, when the price closed at $6.50. The drop also marked the biggest single‑day percentage decline since June 5, when the stock fell 17%.
Since the start of the year, USA Rare Earth’s stock has fallen about 50%, whereas it rose 15% over the full year of 2025.
Other rare‑earth related stocks also slipped on Monday, including Critical Metals (CRML‑US), MP Materials (MP‑US) and Rare Earths Americas (REA‑US).

William Blair analysts wrote that USA Rare Earth “is gradually building a foundation for significant future growth,” but the recent raw‑material supply shortage adds pressure to a short‑term challenge the company already faces. Rare‑earth raw materials refer to any ore or waste containing rare‑earth elements that can be further processed.
Earlier this year the Trump administration announced an investment and partnership with USA Rare Earth, as the U.S. government views the rare‑earth sector as a matter of national security.

Rare‑earth elements are actually relatively abundant in the crust, but because they rarely occur in pure form, extraction and refining are difficult, which is why they are called “rare earths.” These minerals are widely used in energy, transportation and, of course, artificial‑intelligence industries.
William Blair analysts said, “Given the ongoing impact of raw‑material shortages, we have pushed our revenue and margin forecasts out significantly to 2028.”

The analysts also noted that beyond supply issues, companies typically encounter a range of operational challenges when trying to increase output and scale production, and the broader rare‑earth industry carries wider‑reaching risks.

However, USA Rare Earth still has a favorable condition. The analysts pointed out that the company held over $1 billion in cash as of the end of the quarter ending September 30, enough to ensure ample liquidity next year and even if raw‑material supply problems persist longer.

items.title: Anthropic CEO示警AI算力投資難題！已承諾砸9,000億美元
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO Warns of AI Computing Investment Challenges! Promises to Spend $900 Billion
paras: Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）坦言，隨著人工智慧（AI）產業快速成長，公司在採購運算資源時面臨高度不確定性，必須精準預測未來數年的需求，避免投入過多資金卻無法轉化為營收，或因算力不足而無法滿足客戶需求、推進新模型研發。
根據《Business Insider》報導，阿莫戴近日在一場直播中與摩根大通執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）對談，討論Anthropic即將進行的首次公開募股（IPO）。Anthropic目標估值達1.4兆美元，預計本周四（19日）掛牌交易。
阿莫戴指出，AI技術進步速度極快，但技術發展究竟能以多快的速度轉化為商業價值，目前仍難以預測，使公司在規劃未來算力需求時面臨重大挑戰。他表示，這項工作會隨時間變得更加棘手，因為每年的相關成本都愈來愈高。
Anthropic在IPO公開說明書中揭露，已承諾投入約9,000億美元進行基礎設施投資，其中約一半須在2030年前支付。
阿莫戴表示，如果公司採購的運算資源超過實際需求，成本可能大幅領先營收，形成沉重負擔；但若投資不足，則可能無法提供客戶所需的AI服務，也會影響下一代AI模型的研發。
他坦言，這是一項「非常困難的問題」。
面對算力需求難以預測的問題，阿莫戴表示，Anthropic將根據新產品及Claude Code等熱門產品的成長動能，盡可能準確評估未來需求。
他也提出兩項緩衝機制，協助公司因應算力需求的不確定性。首先是毛利率。阿莫戴肯定公司能從每單位運算資源創造可觀收益，而分析師也將毛利率視為評估Anthropic營運實力的重要指標之一。
第二項則是充裕的現金部位。根據IPO公開說明書，截至9月30日，Anthropic持有超過950億美元的現金及約當現金，另有360億美元短期投資。此次IPO也將為公司帶來數十億美元資金。
阿莫戴表示，Anthropic的策略是事先採購「相對少量」的算力，即使需求低於預期，也能讓公司處於較有利的位置。如果需求高於預期，公司則有足夠現金，可透過現貨市場即時採購算力，作為短期應急方案。
他對此表示，即使業務發展一度不如預期，公司也有足夠的資源支應，能夠有效降低風險。
Anthropic預計周三（18日）訂定IPO價格，並於周四開始掛牌交易。
paras_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei admitted that as the AI industry grows rapidly, the company faces high uncertainty when procuring computing resources, needing to accurately forecast demand for the next few years to avoid overinvesting without revenue conversion or underinvesting and failing to meet customer needs and model development.

According to Business Insider, Amodei recently discussed Anthropic’s upcoming IPO with JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon in a live broadcast, with a target valuation of $1.4 trillion and a planned listing on Thursday the 19th.

Amodei noted that AI technology advances quickly, but how fast it translates into commercial value remains unpredictable, creating major challenges for planning future computing needs, and that this task will become more difficult as annual costs rise.
In its IPO prospectus, Anthropic disclosed a commitment to invest roughly $900 billion in infrastructure, about half of which must be paid before 2030.

Amodei said that if the company procures more computing resources than needed, costs could far outpace revenue, creating a heavy burden; conversely, insufficient investment could prevent delivering required AI services and hamper next‑generation model development.
He admitted that this is a "very difficult problem."

To address the unpredictable computing demand, Amodei said Anthropic will evaluate future needs as accurately as possible based on growth momentum from new products and popular offerings like Claude Code.

He outlined two buffer mechanisms to manage uncertainty. First, gross margin: Amodei affirmed the company can generate substantial revenue per unit of computing resource, and analysts view gross margin as a key indicator of Anthropic’s operational strength.

Second, ample cash reserves: as of September 30, the IPO prospectus shows Anthropic holding over $95 billion in cash and cash equivalents, plus $36 billion in short‑term investments, and the IPO will bring in billions more.

Amodei explained that Anthropic’s strategy is to pre‑purchase a "relatively small" amount of computing power, positioning the company favorably if demand falls short, while having sufficient cash to buy power on the spot market as a short‑term contingency if demand exceeds expectations.
He added that even if business growth lags, the company has enough resources to support it and effectively reduce risk.
Anthropic plans to set its IPO price on Wednesday the 18th and begin trading on Thursday.

items.title: 輝達股價自高點崩跌35%！空頭帳面大賺240億美元 散戶趁低點創紀錄搶進
items.title_en: NVIDIA Stock Plummets 35% From Peak! Short Sellers Net $24 Billion on Paper While Retail Investors Rush In at Record Low
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳離任後，股價隨相關醜聞發酵而大幅下挫，目前已自歷史高點回跌35%，放空者的帳面獲利預估達到240億美元。同一時間，散戶則趁低買進。
輝達股價上周創下美國總統川普2025年4月「解放日」關稅措施宣布以來最大單周跌幅之後，周一再下挫4.1%。
Integrity資產管理公司投資組合經理Joe Gilbert說：「先前高度看好輝達的持股者可能試圖保住獲利，因此股價仍可能進一步下跌。黃仁勳離開後，公司出現了願景真空。」

空頭趁勢加碼 放空部位達460億美元

黃仁勳因與下屬以及一名疑為中國間諜的女子發生婚外情而遭董事會調查並撤換，是導致輝達股價暴跌的主因。但在此事發生前，科技股已經陷入動盪一段時間，主因是市場擔憂資本密集的人工智慧(AI)基建投資無法持續，而美國期中選舉之後，部分當選候選人承諾將反對資料中心快速擴張，更讓投資人繃緊神經。
根據S3 Partners數據，11月初輝達賣壓加劇之際，逆勢交易者加碼放空押注。放空餘額是衡量市場看空情緒的指標，目前放空餘額約占輝達流通在外股數的1.22%，名目價值約460億美元。

散戶趁低點進場 單周買進20億美元創紀錄

在股價重挫之際，部分投資人開始進場逢低買進。市場數據與研究公司Vanda的資料顯示，散戶上周在輝達股價遭遇賣壓期間，買進金額達到創紀錄的20億美元。
Roundhill Financial執行長Dave Mazza說：「輝達已從市場寵兒變成市場棄兒，這種評價重置正是目前值得關注的原因。看空聲浪很大，但散戶正在進場，除了最糟糕的情境外，無論採取哪種情境評估，這檔股票的估值倍數都具有吸引力。這是趁市場恐慌買進的機會，而不是利多出盡後賣出的時機。」
輝達下一個可能的股價催化劑，是預定周二美股收盤後公布的財報。
晨星投資服務(Morningstar Investment Services)股票策略師Brian Colello說：「我們認為輝達將如過去許多季一樣，公布優於市場預期的業績並上修財測。畢竟，這起事件是在第3季帳目結算後才發生的。」
不過他也指出：「如果輝達真的出現問題，或第3季期間就已經出現問題，而公司在財報中揭露這些情況，將對股價造成非常大的衝擊。」
paras_en: After former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, NVIDIA (NVDA-US) saw its share price tumble dramatically as related scandals unfolded, now down 35% from its historic high, with short sellers’ paper gains estimated at $24 billion. At the same time, retail investors are buying at the lows.
NVIDIA’s stock posted the biggest weekly decline since President Trump announced the April 2025 “Liberation Day” tariff measures, and on Monday it fell another 4.1%.

Joe Gilbert, portfolio manager at Integrity Asset Management, said: “Investors who were previously very bullish on NVIDIA may try to lock in profits, so the stock could fall further. Huang’s departure has left a vision vacuum at the company.”

Short sellers are adding to the trend, with short positions now totalling $46 billion. Huang was investigated and removed by the board over an alleged affair with a subordinate and a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, which sparked the stock’s plunge. Even before that, tech stocks had been volatile as investors worried that capital‑intensive AI infrastructure spending might not be sustainable, and after the U.S. midterm elections some winning candidates pledged to curb rapid data‑center expansion, tightening nerves further.

According to S3 Partners data, as selling pressure on NVIDIA intensified in early November, contrarian traders increased their short bets. The short‑interest ratio, a gauge of bearish sentiment, now stands at about 1.22% of NVIDIA’s float, representing a notional value of roughly $46 billion.

Retail investors are buying at the dip, setting a record by purchasing $2 billion worth of shares in a single week. As the stock slumped, some investors stepped in to buy low. Market data and research firm Vanda show that retail investors spent a record $2 billion buying NVIDIA shares last week amid the selling pressure.

Dave Mazza, CEO of Roundhill Financial, said: “NVIDIA has gone from market darling to market outcast, and this valuation reset is the key story right now. Bearish sentiment is strong, but retail investors are coming in; aside from the worst‑case scenario, the stock’s valuation multiples remain attractive under any scenario. This is a buying opportunity driven by market fear, not a time to sell after all the good news has been priced in.”
The next possible catalyst for NVIDIA’s share price is its earnings report scheduled for release after the U.S. market close on Tuesday.

Brian Colello, stock strategist at Morningstar Investment Services, said: “We expect NVIDIA, as in many past quarters, to report results that beat market expectations and to raise its guidance. After all, this episode occurred after the Q3 close.”
He added: “If NVIDIA does have a problem, or if issues emerged during Q3 and the company discloses them in the earnings report, the impact on the stock could be huge.”

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞財報前續抱輝達賣權 「短期內再便宜都不買！」
items.title_en: "The Big Short" Investor Burry Holds Nvidia Put Options Ahead of Earnings, Says He Won’t Buy Even If It Gets Cheaper
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 將於美東時間週二 (17 日) 公布財報，這是共同創辦人黃仁勳卸任後的首場財報會議。因電影《大賣空》聞名的投資人貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 表示，即使輝達股價繼續下跌，短期內無論跌到什麼價位，他都不會買進。他仍持有明年 2 月到期的輝達賣權，但也坦言，散戶買盤「很有可能」在短期內推升股價。
黃仁勳在媒體披露婚外情後，於上週四 (12 日) 辭去輝達總裁、執行長及董事職務。輝達 (NVDA-US) 週一下跌 4.12% 至每股 156.14 美元，今年以來已累計跌幅達17.32%。
財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 將在董事會尋找正式接班人期間兼任代理執行長，並首度以代理執行長身分主持財報電話會議。
輝達先前預估，本季營收為 1,080 億美元，上下浮動 2%，財測假設中國資料中心運算業務的營收為零。
貝瑞上週日 (15 日) 在 Substack 發文表示：「短期內，無論價格如何，我都不會買入這檔股票 (輝達)，我的直覺告訴我，事情還有不對勁的地方。我擔心輝達還有一些真正的問題會浮上檯面。」
他關注輝達對供應商做出的採購承諾、公司建立的軟硬體生態系能否維持，以及輝達在 AI 投資熱潮中居於核心地位，一旦需求放緩將承受多大衝擊。
貝瑞盯客戶壓價與延後採購
貝瑞表示，他正觀察競爭對手和客戶是否會趁輝達高層交接之際採取行動，尤其是客戶是否會要求更低的晶片價格，或把採購時程往後延。若客戶成功壓價，輝達的利潤率恐承壓。
若客戶等到資料中心接近完工才下單，輝達也可能更難像過去一樣提前數月敲定交易。輝達未立即回應置評請求。
貝瑞過去一年多次質疑 AI 需求背後的融資安排。
他認為，輝達一方面大舉投資 AI 公司，一方面資助客戶採購自家晶片，一旦產業投資降溫，公司可能同時面臨訂單放緩及投資部位承壓。
他也點名輝達在 2025 年底調整營收的地區歸類方式，從依帳單或發票地址統計，改為依客戶的區域總部所在地認列。貝瑞認為，這使外界更難從財報判斷晶片最終在哪裡安裝及使用。
續抱輝達賣權 加碼要看價格
貝瑞表示，他仍持有 2027 年 2 月到期的輝達賣權。被問及是否加碼時，他說要看能以多低的價格買到，並認為之後可能出現更好的進場時機。
他曾考慮在財報前採取跨式策略，同時買進履約價及到期日相同的買權與賣權，押注股價在財報後大幅波動，但認為當時的隱含波動率可能過高，推升了選擇權成本。
他的空頭部位也涵蓋那斯達克 100 指數、VanEck 半導體 ETF (SMH-US)、大都會人壽 (MET-US) 和 Palantir (PLTR-US)。他在週一 (16 日) 的部落格文章中表示，已趁股價持續下探時出清甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 賣權，並平掉最後一部分開拓重工 (CAT-US) 賣權。
貝瑞 9 月將輝達、Palantir 等個股的直接放空部位改為賣權。
到了 10 月，空頭曝險主要集中在 2027 年 4 月到期的那斯達克 100 指數賣權，以及同年 6 月到期的 SMH 賣權。輝達是 SMH 最大持股。
本月稍早，SMH 下跌約 11% 後，貝瑞賣出約四分之一的相關賣權，一週後再買回部分部位，並趁那斯達克 100 指數自約 27,000 點反彈時，將指數賣權部位增至原先的兩倍。
馬斯克憂握手協議生變 分析師緊盯下一輪產能談判
馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 上週六 (14 日) 在社群平台 X 表示，輝達許多交易靠黃仁勳握手拍板，沒有簽署書面合約。黃仁勳卸任後，他認為至少有部分關鍵交易可能流失。
研究機構 Moor Insights & Strategy 分析師 Patrick Moorhead 則表示，有幾家輝達大客戶的執行長曾告訴他，黃仁勳能在會議現場拍板數十億美元的承諾。
他推測，供應商也見識過黃仁勳同樣的決策速度。不過，他認為外界高估了最大幾筆既有交易的風險，因為這些交易已有書面協議。
輝達揭露，截至 7 月 26 日，供應與產能承諾增加至 2,790 億美元，高於前一季的 1,190 億美元，主要用於確保記憶體及製造產能。其中 2,670 億美元的承諾預計在 2029 會計年度結束前履行，部分協議在輝達正式下單前仍可調整或取消。
Moorhead 表示，輝達至少未來 18 個月的供應與產品計畫大致底定，克雷斯也已致電供應商穩定合作關係。他更關注下一輪談判。如果輝達需要更長時間才能拍板，競爭對手就有機會先搶下原本可能由黃仁勳當場敲定的產能。
黃仁勳卸任後 對中晶片政策也成焦點
半導體研究機構 SemiAnalysis 創辦人 Dylan Patel 在 ChinaTalk 播客上表示，失去黃仁勳後，「輝達會是一家弱得多的公司」。他認為，黃仁勳卸任也讓美國產業界在華府討論中國企業可以取得多少美國算力時，少了一個有影響力的聲音。
Patel 指出，中國企業希望取得美國晶片，美國伺服器業者也仰賴中國零組件。
他說，輝達最大的印刷電路板供應商就是一家中國企業。若華府全面切斷中國取得先進晶片的管道，包括限制中國企業在海外租用算力，北京可能反過來限制輝達、谷歌和亞馬遜伺服器所需的零組件出口。
美國國會兩黨已有議員推動收緊對中晶片出口限制。
克雷斯週二首度以代理執行長身分面對分析師，除了營收能否達到 1,080 億美元的財測中值，市場也將關注黃仁勳過去能當場拍板的數十億美元採購與產能承諾，接下來將由誰決定。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) will release its earnings on Tuesday, the 17th, Eastern Time, marking the first earnings call since co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down. Investor Michael Burry, made famous by the film "The Big Short," said that even if Nvidia’s share price keeps falling, he will not buy the stock at any price in the short term. He still holds Nvidia put options expiring in February 2027, but admits that retail buying could "very likely" lift the price in the near term.

After media reports of an extramarital affair, Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s president, CEO and director last Thursday, the 12th. Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell 4.12% on Monday to $156.14 per share, down 17.32% year‑to‑date.
Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, and will chair the earnings call in her interim capacity for the first time.
Nvidia previously projected Q2 revenue of $108 billion, plus or minus 2%, assuming zero revenue from its China data‑center computing business.

Burry wrote on Substack last Sunday, the 15th: "In the short term, no matter the price, I will not buy Nvidia stock. My gut tells me something still isn’t right. I’m worried that real problems at Nvidia will surface."

He is watching Nvidia’s procurement commitments to suppliers, whether its hardware‑software ecosystem can be sustained, and how much impact a slowdown in AI demand would have on a company that sits at the centre of the AI investment boom.
Burry watches customers pressuring prices and delaying purchases

Burry says he is watching whether rivals and customers will act during Nvidia’s leadership transition, especially if customers demand lower chip prices or push back procurement schedules. If customers succeed in price‑pressuring, Nvidia’s margins could be squeezed.

If customers wait until data‑center construction is near completion before ordering, Nvidia may find it harder to lock in deals months in advance as it has in the past. Nvidia did not immediately respond to comment requests.
Over the past year Burry has repeatedly questioned the financing behind AI demand.

He believes Nvidia is simultaneously pouring money into AI firms and subsidising customers to buy its chips; a cooling of industry investment could hit both order flow and Nvidia’s own investment positions.

He also called out Nvidia’s change in revenue geography reporting slated for the end of 2025, shifting from billing‑address or invoice‑address accounting to recognizing revenue based on the customer’s regional headquarters. Burry says this makes it harder for outsiders to tell where chips are ultimately installed and used from the financial statements.
Continuing to hold Nvidia puts, adding more depends on price

Burry says he still holds Nvidia put options expiring in February 2027. When asked if he would add to the position, he said it depends on how low he can buy them and that a better entry point may appear later.

He once considered a straddle before the earnings release—buying calls and puts with the same strike and expiry to bet on a big post‑earnings move—but felt the implied volatility was too high at the time, inflating option costs.

His short positions also include the Nasdaq‑100 index, VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US), MetLife (MET‑US) and Palantir (PLTR‑US). In a blog post on Monday the 16th he said he had sold his Oracle (ORCL‑US) puts as the stock kept falling and had closed the last of his Caterpillar (CAT‑US) put exposure.
In September Burry switched his outright short positions in Nvidia, Palantir and other stocks to put options.
By October his short exposure was mainly concentrated in Nasdaq‑100 puts expiring April 2027 and SMH puts expiring June 2027. Nvidia is SMH’s largest holding.

Earlier this month, after SMH fell about 11%, Burry sold roughly a quarter of the related puts, bought back part of the position a week later, and doubled his Nasdaq‑100 put exposure when the index rebounded from around 27,000 points.
Musk worries a handshake deal could fall apart; analysts watch the next capacity negotiations

Elon Musk said on X last Saturday the 14th that many Nvidia deals were sealed by Jensen Huang’s handshake, without written contracts. With Huang out, Musk thinks at least some key deals could be lost.
Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Patrick Moorhead said several CEOs of Nvidia’s biggest customers told him that Huang could make multi‑billion‑dollar commitments on the spot during meetings.
He speculates that suppliers have also seen Huang’s rapid decision‑making, but believes the market overestimates the risk to the biggest existing deals because they already have written agreements.

Nvidia disclosed that as of July 26, supply and capacity commitments rose to $279 billion, up from $119 billion in the prior quarter, mainly to secure memory and manufacturing capacity. About $267 billion of those commitments are expected to be fulfilled by the end of fiscal 2029, and some agreements can still be adjusted or cancelled before Nvidia formally places orders.

Moorhead said Nvidia’s supply and product plans for at least the next 18 months are basically set, and Kress has already called suppliers to stabilise relationships. He is more focused on the next round of negotiations: if Nvidia needs longer to seal deals, rivals could snap up capacity that Huang would have closed on the spot.
After Huang’s departure, China chip policy also becomes a focus

Dylan Patel, founder of semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis, said on the ChinaTalk podcast that without Huang, "Nvidia would be a much weaker company." He believes Huang’s exit also removes an influential voice from U.S. industry discussions in Washington about how much computing power Chinese firms can obtain from the United States.
Patel noted that Chinese companies want U.S. chips and U.S. server makers also rely on Chinese components.

He said Nvidia’s biggest printed‑circuit‑board supplier is a Chinese firm. If Washington were to completely cut off China’s access to advanced chips—including restricting Chinese firms from renting overseas compute power—Beijing might retaliate by limiting exports of the components needed for Nvidia, Google and Amazon servers.
Both parties in the U.S. Congress have members pushing to tighten export restrictions on chips to China.

Kress will appear as interim CEO for the first time on Tuesday, and analysts will watch not only whether revenue hits the mid‑point of the $108 billion forecast, but also who will make the on‑the‑spot multi‑billion‑dollar procurement and capacity commitments that Jensen Huang used to decide in person.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至2025年4月來最高 交易員押注Fed升息
paras: 美元週一(16日)升至2025年4月以來最高，兌主要貨幣持續走強。上週公布的通膨數據高於預期，加上聯準會(Fed)官員釋出鷹派訊號，支撐美元近期漲勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報103.50，創2025年4月2日以來最高。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，報1.1007美元。
美國總統川普去年4月公布「解放日」關稅政策後，市場擔憂美國資產吸引力下降，美元一度大幅走弱。不過，隨著美國經濟展現穩健成長，股市表現也相當強勁，美元已逐步收復失土，部分恢復美國資產對投資人的吸引力。
上週公布的通膨數據偏熱，加上市場押注聯準會可能進一步升息，近期進一步推升美元。
宏觀研究與策略公司Macro Hive研究員Benjamin Ford表示，「在通膨壓力仍令人不安，且2027年可能出現更鷹派政策意外的情況下，年底前歐元兌美元匯率跌至1.08，並非不可能。」
上週公布的數據顯示，美國10月消費者物價漲幅高於預期，進一步鞏固市場對聯準會下個月升息的預期。
通膨數據公布後，市場一度提高對聯準會12月會議升息2碼的押注。此前，聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)曾提出，若通膨數據達到一定門檻，便可考慮加快升息步調。
根據芝商所FedWatch工具，聯邦基金利率期貨目前反映，市場預期聯準會在12月9日結束的下一次為期兩天的政策會議上，升息1碼的機率達95%。
Macro Hive的Ford在報告中指出，「聯準會短期內恐難以擺脫通膨壓力，原因有二。首先，透過各地區調查推算的全國隱含通膨指標，顯示價格壓力正在加速升溫。」
他接著表示，「其次，通膨升溫之際，企業利潤率也有所改善，代表企業能將較高成本轉嫁給消費者，而薪資調漲的可能性也正在增加。」
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)週一表示，新興科技將對經濟產生重大影響，但未來可能出現不同情境：一種是經濟成長加速，且成長成果廣泛共享，另一種則是，如果預期中的投資報酬不如預期，可能導致失業率上升，甚至經濟成長放緩。
交易員接下來將關注AI產業指標企業輝達(NVDA-US)週二公布的第三季財報，以及Anthropic本週的市場首秀，藉此判斷投資人的風險偏好。
日元干預風險升高
